name: Woman Wearing Make Up
overview: The Scriptures present the image of a woman wearing makeup within contexts that warn against using outward adornment to mask inner corruption or to seduce in a way that leads to spiritual danger. Proverbs 7:10 describes a woman adorned like a harlot, highlighting the deceitfulness behind such appearance. Jeremiah 4:30 and Ezekiel 23:40 further depict the futility and judgment associated with painting the face and decorating oneself to attract others, emphasizing that external beauty cannot hide the consequences of sin or replace true righteousness.
